home.introTitle: An EPC partner for water in Qatar
home.introBody1: Green Energy Water Treatment is a Doha-based engineering, procurement, and construction company focused on the full lifecycle of water systems — from feed-water analysis and process design through commissioning, supply, and long-term operation.
home.introBody2: We design around each client's salinity, throughput, and reliability requirements, and we deliver with locally manufactured reverse osmosis membranes, traceable spare parts, and an in-country service team.
home.qaBody: Our reverse osmosis membranes are produced in Qatar, shortening lead times for replacements and giving clients a credible local supply chain alongside the imported alternatives.
home.whyBody: A focused team across process engineering, fabrication, and operations — backed by Qatari manufacturing and a regional service footprint.
home.servicesBody: Membrane treatment, filtration, wastewater, ultra-pure water, and the operations and supply backbone that keeps systems running.
home.partnersLabel: Trusted across the region's water sector
home.ctaTitle: Have a water system to scope?
home.ctaBody: Tell us the source water, throughput target, and constraints — we'll come back with a feasible approach.

about.headerTitle: A Qatari engineering company built around water.
about.headerLede: We design, supply, install, and operate water treatment systems across Qatar and the wider region — with a manufacturing capability for membranes that few peers can match.
about.missionTitle: Make reliable, locally engineered water treatment the default in Qatar.
about.missionBody: We bring engineering, procurement, construction, and operations under one roof so clients work with a single accountable partner from feasibility through years of running plant.
about.visionTitle: Qatari water systems, Qatari supply chains.
about.visionBody: We invest in domestic manufacturing — most visibly in our local RO membrane production — so that Qatar's water infrastructure depends less on imported consumables and more on capability built here.
about.industriesBody: Our work spans municipal water utilities, oil and gas, industrial process water, and high-purity applications for healthcare and laboratories.
about.teamBody: A board with deep operating experience across Qatar's energy, industrial, and infrastructure sectors.

services.indexTitle: End-to-end water treatment, designed for Qatar.
services.indexLede: From source water characterization to long-term operations, our service lines cover the full water cycle for industrial, municipal, and high-purity clients.

insights.indexLede: Practical reads on membrane technology, treatment economics, and the realities of operating water plant in the Gulf.
